_note: SAMPLE DATA for a fictional hospital. Replace every entry with content the hospital has approved before go-live.

locations.name: Sunrise Hospital, Main Campus
locations.opd_hours: OPD Mon–Sat, 8 am–8 pm. Emergency and pharmacy 24×7.

locations.name: Sunrise City Clinic, Lake View
locations.opd_hours: Mon–Sat 9 am–9 pm, Sun 10 am–2 pm

specialties.name: Orthopaedics
specialties.prep: Bring any previous X-rays or MRI scans and wear loose clothing so the affected joint can be examined.

specialties.name: Cardiology
specialties.prep: Bring previous ECGs, echo reports and your current medicines. Do not stop any heart medicine before the visit.

specialties.name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology
specialties.prep: Bring previous scan reports and note the date of your last period.

specialties.name: Paediatrics
specialties.prep: Bring your child's vaccination card and growth records.

specialties.name: Dermatology
specialties.prep: Please avoid applying creams or make-up on the affected area on the day of the visit.

specialties.name: Neurology
specialties.prep: Bring any previous CT or MRI scans and a note of when symptoms started.

specialties.name: ENT
specialties.prep: Bring previous hearing tests or scans if you have them.

specialties.name: General Medicine
specialties.prep: Bring recent blood reports and a list of medicines you take.

packages.name: Executive Health Check
packages.tests: 75 tests incl. blood, ECG, chest X-ray, ultrasound abdomen, doctor and diet consult

packages.name: Heart Check
packages.tests: ECG, 2D Echo, TMT, lipid profile, blood sugar, cardiologist consult
packages.prep: Fast for 10–12 hours. Wear sports shoes for the treadmill test.

packages.name: Women's Wellness Check
packages.tests: Pap smear, breast ultrasound, thyroid, vitamin D, haemoglobin, gynaecologist consult
packages.prep: Fast for 10 hours. Avoid booking during your period.

packages.name: Diabetes Care Check
packages.tests: HbA1c, fasting and post-meal sugar, kidney function, eye screening, diabetologist consult
packages.prep: Fast for 10 hours, then have breakfast at the hospital for the post-meal test.

faqs.title: OPD timings
faqs.answer:
*Main Campus*: OPD Mon–Sat, 8 am–8 pm. Emergency and pharmacy are open 24×7.
*City Clinic, Lake View*: Mon–Sat 9 am–9 pm, Sun 10 am–2 pm.

faqs.title: Visiting hours
faqs.answer: Visiting hours are 11 am–12 pm and 5–7 pm. One visitor at a time per patient. ICU visits are 6–6:30 pm only.

faqs.title: What to bring
faqs.answer: Please bring a photo ID, your previous prescriptions and reports, a list of medicines you take, and your insurance card if you plan to use it.

faqs.title: Reports and results
faqs.answer: Reports are sent here on WhatsApp as a secure link once they are ready. You will verify with an OTP before opening them. You can also collect printed copies from the Reports counter, Ground floor.

faqs.title: Pharmacy
faqs.answer: The pharmacy at Main Campus is open 24×7. The City Clinic pharmacy is open during clinic hours.

faqs.title: Parking
faqs.answer:
*Main Campus*: Basement 2, first hour free.
*City Clinic*: Lake View Mall parking, Level P1.

faqs.title: Cancellation and refunds
faqs.answer: You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 2 hours before your appointment. Prepaid consultation fees are refunded within 5–7 working days.
